interface.signature: find_centroids(n: int, parents: List[int], queries: List[int]) -> List[int]

preconditions.description: The size of the initial tree is between 2 and 300,000.
The number of queries is between 1 and 300,000.

preconditions.expression: 1 <= pi <= n for all i in range(2, n+1)
preconditions.description: Each parent index is within the range of node indices.

preconditions.expression: The input defines a correct tree
preconditions.description: The parent indices form a connected acyclic graph with node 1 as the root.

postconditions.description: The number of centroids returned is equal to the number of queries.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= centroid <= n for centroid in centroids)
postconditions.description: Each centroid index is within the range of node indices.

postconditions.expression: all(centroid in find_subtree_nodes(n, parents, query_node) for centroid, query_node in zip(centroids, queries))
postconditions.description: Each centroid is a valid centroid of the corresponding subtree.
